static_traits.name: Wang Lin
static_traits.family_status: Living alone，与一只宠物狗同住
static_traits.social_status: At the workplace, difficulty connecting with colleagues because of worry about being judged; has one close friend who can be confided in
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；without既往类似心理问题或心理治疗史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，逻辑较好，能自我Reflection并Identify automatic thoughts；情绪基调偏Anxiety、自我关注度高；配合度Good，语速平稳

basic_info.main_problem: Feels that colleagues judge me because I often talk about my dog; I believe they think I am overly obsessed with my pet and hold negative views of me.

core_beliefs: 我是令人反感/怪异的人
My worth depends on what others think of me

special_situations.event: 几个月前without意听到同事对“过度谈论宠物的人”的负面评论
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I talk about my dog at work, I will be considered overly obsessed and strange
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to avoid talking about the pet and steers the conversation back to work topics
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am annoying, that I am a weirdo

special_situations.event: Pet or other personal topics come up in office conversation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果谈及个人兴趣，就会被负面评价，显得not专业
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 迅速Displacement话题或保持沉默，减少参与
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They definitely think I am annoying and weird in their hearts

special_situations.event: 注意到同事表情或语气not够热情时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果对方看起来not热情，就说明他们在评判我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Stops sharing personal content, talks only about facts and work details
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们在暗地里not喜欢我/觉得我很烦

special_situations.event: Before preparing to share any personal content at work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I expose real interests, I will be labeled 'weird' and excluded
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Completely avoids self-disclosure, communicates only about work
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Once I mention the dog, they will look down on me

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被同事接纳，能够Freedom分享真实兴趣并被看见与尊重
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被评判、羞辱与排斥
defense_goal: Lowers the risk of being judged by keeping distance and avoiding personal topics
Narrows the topic to work matters to gain a sense of safety

object_relations.self_representation: A person easily disliked, who needs to hide oneself carefully
object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔、带有negate性的同事群体

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When office conversation turns to pets or other personal topics
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Experiences colleagues as belittling oneself like past negative commenters (viewing others as critics)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 迅速转回工作议题，use简短、客观的语句；避免自我披露，减少眼神接触。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当觉察到对方表情not够热情或沉默时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interprets neutral silence/fatigue as belittling and disgust toward oneself
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Reporting work details rationally, avoiding expressing feelings, ending conversations in a flat tone.

manifestations: Avoids personal topics for fear of being judged, reducing self-disclosure and sense of connection
Feels isolated at work, difficult to build close relationships with colleagues
下班后仍为他人看法所困扰，Sleep affected

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Highly self-censors before discussing personal topics; shrinks expression out of worry about being judged
Frequently speculates about others' thoughts, cautiously controls words and actions

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: 当对话涉及宠物/个人内容时立刻Displacement至工作话题
Avoids deep contact by minimizing participation and quickly ending conversations

exception_events.target_problem: 在办公室对话涉及个人/宠物话题时，Wang Lin通常会强烈Anxiety、读心式揣测被评判，并通过沉默或Displacement话题撤退，导致互动变得疏离。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在仅讨论工作相关内容的几次交流中，Wang Linhave not像往常那样回避，能够自然地参与讨论，互动顺畅，主观Anxiety明显较低。
exception_events.reason: 线索：话题聚焦在工作、评价威胁较低；做法not同：将注意力放在任务与事实上，更易获得掌控感与安全感。

positive_force: Has the willingness to seek help and is willing to try cognitive restructuring and reality testing
能识do not自身的自动化思维并进行初步再评价
Has one close friend to confide in who provides basic support
在非个人话题的工作交流中能Good互动，具备有效沟通能力
negative_force: Excessive reliance on external evaluation to determine self-worth (External Validation)
常以读心术和预测not yet来来解读他人（Mind Reading、Fortune Telling）
回避个人话题导致人际连接受损与Loneliness感加重

target_behavior.behavior: In work settings, avoids personal topics and minimizes participation
antecedent: Office conversations involving pets or other personal topics
察觉到同事表情/语气not热情
Recalls a colleague's comment about 'talking too much about pets'
target_behavior.core_reason: Fears being judged and humiliated, with mind reading and catastrophic predictions of negative outcomes
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the possibility of negative evaluation and shame, gaining a temporary sense of safety
target_behavior.consequence: 人际连接受损、Loneliness感增加、Decline in work performance

Before sleep, thinks about whether colleagues see one as 'weird'
